entries.title: Claude can sign itself back in after a resumed conversation fails to open
entries.body: When a crewmate's earlier Claude conversation could not be reopened, the app kept Claude's sign-in marked as busy. After that, the app no longer renewed the sign-in on its own until you restarted it. The app now frees the sign-in when a resume fails, so renewal keeps working.
entries.noPicture: This fixes a sign-in held after a failed resume without changing a view or control.
